mission_description: Adapt packages/app WebUI to the rewritten agent runtime with nested session tree workbench and first-class agent manager.

features.description: Research WebUI session tree and agent manager gaps
expectedBehavior: Current WebUI session hierarchy behavior is mapped
Current agent UI/API capability and gaps are mapped
Implementation tasks and verification points are identified
verificationSteps: Review research outputs for both Session Tree Workbench and Agent Manager
features.audit_notes: Research completed by Session Tree and Agent Manager explorers. Session tree gaps: root-only initial loading, no recursive sidebar renderer, direct-children-only API, trim loses grandchildren. Agent manager gaps: runtime has schema/read support but lacks management/write/disable API and Settings tab.

expectedBehavior: Nested sessions render as a multi-level tree
Every child session is navigable and interactive
Session state indicators propagate through the tree without hiding child blockers
verificationSteps: Run affected packages/app tests for layout/sidebar/session tree behavior
features.audit_notes: Final re-review PASS: descendants loading uses a single descendantsBatch call for new roots, backend scans current directory once with project/directory guard, and recursive tree render/nav share effective expanded state with active lineage. Focused app/backend tests passed; opencode, sdk, and app typechecks now pass after the follow-up SDK Config.plugin/SSE options drift fix.

expectedBehavior: Settings exposes an Agents management tab
Users can list, create, edit, disable, and enable agents
Agent permission mode and entry flags match the new runtime schema
verificationSteps: Run backend agent route tests if routes are added
Run affected packages/app tests for settings agent manager
Run packages/opencode and packages/app typecheck as applicable
features.audit_notes: MOD-W02 completed. Backend/API/SDK phase exposes /agent/manage list/get/validate/create/update/state, includes builtin fallback default, writes package/builtin edits as user/project overrides, keeps disabled agents visible in manage and hidden from regular /agent, and validate action=create reports duplicate ids. WebUI Settings now has an Agents tab with list/create/edit/enable/disable; form defaults to custom independent permissions, preserves unseen metadata such as workflow_mode/model_preference on no-op saves, clears identity/rules with empty strings, and toggles state using the clicked agent source scope. Focused backend/app tests passed; opencode, sdk, and app typechecks pass.
